scripts.validate: bun run check && bun run lint && bun run cli openapi:validate && bun run test:all
scripts.validate:ci: bun run check && bun run lint:ci && bun run check:module-imports && bun run verify:versions && bun run release:check && bun run build:framework && bun run build:bootstrap && bun run verify:framework && bun run verify:bootstrap && bun run verify:starter && bun run verify:cli && bun run verify:create-strata && bun run verify:generated-app && DOGFOOD_APP=hiroapp APP_KEY_PREFIX=hiroapp APP_NAME=HiroApp API_PREFIX=/api bun run cli openapi:validate && DOGFOOD_APP=hiroapp APP_KEY_PREFIX=hiroapp APP_NAME=HiroApp API_PREFIX=/api bun run cli openapi:check && bun run test:coverage
scripts.verify:framework: bun run build:framework && bun scripts/verify-core-shared-subpaths.ts && bun scripts/verify-bundled-subpaths.ts && bun scripts/verify-optional-peers.ts && bun scripts/verify-no-root-imports.ts && bun scripts/verify-no-shared-barrel-imports.ts && bun scripts/verify-export-types.ts && bun -e "import('./packages/strata-core/dist/index.js').then((m) => { if (typeof m.BaseRepository !== 'function') throw new Error('missing BaseRepository export'); })"
scripts.verify:bootstrap: bun run build:bootstrap && bun -e "import('./packages/strata-bootstrap/dist/index.js').then((m) => { if (typeof m.createWebServer !== 'function') throw new Error('missing createWebServer export'); })"
scripts.validate:host: scripts/with-host-env.sh sh -c 'bun run build:framework && bun run build:bootstrap && STRATA_SCHEMA=fixture bun run cli migrate:fresh --seed && DOGFOOD_APP=hiroapp bun run cli migrate:fresh --seed && SKIP_FIXTURE_TEST_BOOTSTRAP=1 bun run validate:ci'
scripts.test:host: scripts/with-host-env.sh sh -c 'bun run build:framework && bun run build:bootstrap && STRATA_SCHEMA=fixture bun run cli migrate:fresh --seed && DOGFOOD_APP=hiroapp bun run cli migrate:fresh --seed && SKIP_FIXTURE_TEST_BOOTSTRAP=1 QUEUE_DRIVER=sync bun run test:coverage'
scripts.test:all: QUEUE_DRIVER=sync bun run unit && QUEUE_DRIVER=sync bun run integration
